how_it_works.title:
How SEO really works
in 2026
paragraphs: Traditional SEO focused on keywords and backlinks. Today, search engines and LLMs (Large Language Models) evaluate context, topical authority, and semantic structure.
My approach combines the solidity of technical SEO with optimization for generative engines (GEO), preparing your content to be understood, cited, and recommended by AI.

what_is_geo.title: GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)
what_is_geo.p1: Generative engines like ChatGPT, Gemini, or Perplexity don't read your website like Google does. They extract, synthesize, and cite information based on the clarity, structure, and authority of your content.
what_is_geo.p2: Optimization for generative engines (GEO) focuses on making your site the source these systems choose to answer user queries.

expectations.title: What should you keep in mind?
paragraphs: SEO and GEO aren't magic or immediate results. It's a process of building authority that pays off in the medium and long term.
I don't promise #1 positions on Google in a week. I promise a solid, transparent, and technically impeccable strategy that positions your site as a reference in your industry.
